failure_hint: No explicit lag alignment; residual channel misalignment can broaden spectral peak.
Single-tone assumption may be violated by harmonics and segment boundary effects.
Sensitive to noise/phase jitter; sign-flip counts become unstable on non-ideal sinusoidal segments.
Normalization helps amplitude drift but still suffers periodic lag ambiguity.
Full-range lag may pick wrong cycle under periodic ambiguity (less robust than constrained PCCC).
Window averaging stabilizes frequency but loses resolution if segments are short.
Requires relatively clean narrowband structure; phase unwrap noise can bias slope.
Can lock to harmonic/subharmonic peaks when waveform is distorted or truncated.
